# Goal
Kumitate round 92 (hyaku run 15, fresh start, attempt 1). ONE claim C1 = operability, capability acquisition `seat-route` (contract `kumitate-seat-route-v1`): a lane tool `scripts/seat-route.mjs` that reads omp seat transcripts (`~/.omp/agent/sessions/<cwd>/<orchestrator-session>/<Seat>.jsonl`) and reports, per seat, the captured route, the models that actually answered, fallback, failed requests, aborted turns, final state (served/dead/aborted/silent/other/absent) and the redacted last error. It replaces hand-written seat-status prose in round reports (the r90 spot-check routed "12/12 COMPLETE" as an overstatement; Amendment 44's smokes named a model that did not answer). Pre-data evidence: the r91 seat K91Scout captured google-antigravity/claude-opus-5-5 but every answered turn came from minimax-code/MiniMax-M3.1-Flash.

READ FIRST: `/home/vgpnk/Projects/shokunin/kumitate-shokunin/.ufo/waves/round-92/plan.md` (frozen field definitions, predicate, kill rule, pre-data controls). Frozen at lane commit `596f675366ac5822aac5ea1ffc56b1189b17f65c`. The field definitions' executable form is `/home/vgpnk/Projects/shokunin/kumitate-shokunin/.ufo/waves/round-92/probe/oracle92.py` (FROZEN). The counter `/home/vgpnk/Projects/shokunin/kumitate-shokunin/.ufo/waves/round-92/probe/probe92-c1.py` (FROZEN) scores a tool against the oracle on sample A (`probe/sampleA.tsv`, 61 real transcripts), a sample C drawn from `probe/index92.tsv` with salt = sha256 of the tool's bytes, and wave mode on `<wave>-results.json` files. `python3 /home/vgpnk/Projects/shokunin/kumitate-shokunin/.ufo/waves/round-92/probe/probe92-c1.py --tool <TOOL> --index /home/vgpnk/Projects/shokunin/kumitate-shokunin/.ufo/waves/round-92/probe/index92.tsv --sample-a /home/vgpnk/Projects/shokunin/kumitate-shokunin/.ufo/waves/round-92/probe/sampleA.tsv --waves /home/vgpnk/Projects/shokunin/kumitate-shokunin/.ufo/waves/round-91/w1-results.json --out <your seat dir>/<name>.txt`

Kill rule (plan.md): M not HELD twice; a non-positive pre-data control HELD; a committed reproduction of the shipped tool contradicting a field definition on a real transcript; the shipped tool reading/importing/executing anything under `.ufo/waves/round-92/`; scored bytes != shipped bytes. The candidate (once built) lives at `/home/vgpnk/Projects/shokunin/kumitate-shokunin/.ufo/waves/round-92/K92ExecTool/seat-route.mjs`; its builder creates `/home/vgpnk/Projects/shokunin/kumitate-shokunin/.ufo/waves/round-92/K92ExecTool/READY` (one line: sha256 of the candidate) when final. Lane root: `/home/vgpnk/Projects/shokunin/kumitate-shokunin` (detached; read history with `git -C /home/vgpnk/Projects/shokunin/kumitate-shokunin show <rev>:<path>`).
